title: Upgrade Telar
subtitle: A newer version of Telar is available for your site
siteLine: This upgrade is for the site <site>{{repo}}</site>.
gateReason_publish: Your site isn't on the latest version of Telar. Upgrade it before you publish.
gateReason_upload: Your site isn't on the latest version of Telar. Upgrade it before you upload files, because each upload rebuilds the site.
gateReason_import: Your site is set up, but it isn't on the latest version of Telar. Upgrade it before you publish or upload files.
releaseTagOverride: The Compositor is pinned to Telar {{tag}}, not the latest published release.
changesDescription: Upgrading updates the code that builds your site, not your content. Your stories, objects, and settings will not be affected.
upgradeSuccessDetail: Your site has been upgraded to {{version}}. The build is now running.
upgradeFailedDetail: Something went wrong during the upgrade. You can retry or check the GitHub Actions log for details.
insufficientPermissions: The Telar Compositor GitHub App is missing permissions needed to upgrade your site. Review and accept the updated permissions on GitHub, then retry.
insufficientPermissionsConvenorRequired: The Telar Compositor GitHub App is missing permissions needed to upgrade this site. Only the site's convenor can review and accept them on GitHub. Ask them to, and retry once they have.
workflowsModalBody: We recently updated the Telar Compositor GitHub App so you can upgrade your site to the newest version of Telar directly from the Compositor — but first we need you to accept the updated permissions on GitHub.
workflowsModalConsequence: Until your site is on the latest version you won't be able to publish changes from the Compositor. If you'd rather not, you can <0>upgrade manually</0> instead. Apologies for the inconvenience!
rebuild_failed: The build could not be started. Try again in a moment, or check the workflow on GitHub.
rebuild_unconfirmed: The build was started, but GitHub has not reported it yet. Follow it on GitHub.
staleHead: Your repository has changed since this page loaded. Please re-sync before upgrading.
belowMinimum: Your site is running {{version}}, which is too old for the Compositor. Please run the manual upgrade script to reach at least v0.9.0 before connecting.
hint_whatIsUpgrade: An upgrade updates the code that generates your website (layouts, stylesheets, scripts) to the latest version. It does not change your content (stories, objects, images).
hint_whatIsVersion: The version number tells you which release of the Telar framework your site uses. Newer versions may include bug fixes, new features, or design improvements.
hint_whatIsBuild: After the upgrade, GitHub rebuilds your site with the updated code. This usually takes 1-2 minutes.
manualStepsEmpty: No manual steps required for this upgrade.
manualStepsIntro: The upgrade could not do these for you. Check whether each one applies to you.
manualStepsOptionalIntro: You can also do these if you want:
manualStepsUnclassifiedIntro: The Compositor could not tell whether these need anything from you. Read them and decide whether they apply to you.
externalUpgradeToast: Your site was upgraded to v{{version}} externally.
externalDowngradeToast: The repository is on v{{repo}} but the Compositor has v{{d1}}. Please verify.
operationInProgress: A publish, another upgrade or an upload is already running on this site, so the upgrade wasn't started. Try again once it has finished.
preparedOutdated: A newer Telar release came out while we were preparing this upgrade, so we didn't change anything on your site. The page now shows that release. Upgrade again to install it.
deletionsChanged: The files this upgrade removes changed while we were preparing it, so we didn't change anything on your site. The page now lists them. Upgrade again to continue.
releaseUnknown: We couldn't check which Telar release is the latest, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. Try again in a moment.
configExcludeUnreadable: We couldn't add {{values}} to {{key}} in {{file}}, because {{key}} holds a set of named settings instead of a list. We stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. Edit {{file}} on GitHub so that {{key}} is a list, and then upgrade again.
upgradeFileUnreadable: We couldn't read the file {{path}} from your site on GitHub, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything. Try again in a moment.
releaseFileUnreadable: We couldn't read the file {{path}} from Telar {{version}}, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. Try again in a moment.
releaseListUnreadable: We couldn't read the list of Telar releases, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. Try again in a moment.
upgradeFileNotText: The file {{path}} on your site isn't saved as UTF-8 text, so we couldn't read it and stopped the upgrade before changing anything. Open it in a text editor, save it with UTF-8 encoding, upload it to your repository on GitHub again, and then upgrade again.
releaseManifestInvalid: Telar {{version}} includes upgrade instructions we can't use, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything. The problem is in that release, not in your site. Let us know with the Report a bug button (the one with the bug icon) in the top bar.
releaseTreeUnreadable: We couldn't read the list of files in Telar {{version}}, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. Try again in a moment.
sheetUnreadableForRepair: We couldn't edit {{sheet}} without risking changes to its other cells, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. Telar 1.8.0 can't publish {{sheet}} while it has these columns, which it reads as the same field: {{columns}}. On GitHub, keep one of them in {{sheet}} and delete the others, and then upgrade again.
sheetReservedColumn: {{sheet}} has a column named {{column}}, a name Telar 1.8.0 keeps for itself, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. On GitHub, rename or delete the {{column}} column in {{sheet}}, and then upgrade again.
sheetRowsChanged_rows_changed: {{sheet}} has an extra {{columns}} column that Telar 1.8.0 can't publish, and we couldn't delete it without changing which rows your site publishes, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. On GitHub, delete the {{columns}} column from {{sheet}}, check that no row now starts with # or is left empty unless you meant it to, and then upgrade again.
sheetRowsChanged_header_row: {{sheet}} has an extra {{columns}} column that Telar 1.8.0 can't publish, and if we deleted it, your site would publish the sheet's second row of column names as content, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. On GitHub, delete the {{columns}} column and the second row of column names from {{sheet}}, and then upgrade again.
sheetRowsChanged_unsafe: {{sheet}} has an extra {{columns}} column that Telar 1.8.0 can't publish, and we couldn't delete it safely, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. On GitHub, delete the {{columns}} column from {{sheet}}, and then upgrade again.
invalidUpgradeChallenge: Your column choices are no longer valid, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. Start the upgrade again.
publishedTabUnreadable: We couldn't read the {{name}} tab from your published Google Sheet, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. Check that the sheet is still published to the web, and then try again.
publishedSheetUnreadable: We couldn't read your published Google Sheet, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. Check that the sheet is still published to the web, and then try again.
sheetsColumnsRefused_one: Your published Google Sheet has columns that Telar 1.8.0 reads as the same field, in the {{tabs}} tab. We stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. In Google Sheets, keep one column for each field in each tab, delete the others, and then upgrade again.
sheetsColumnsRefused_other: Your published Google Sheet has columns that Telar 1.8.0 reads as the same field, in these tabs: {{tabs}}. We stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. In Google Sheets, keep one column for each field in each tab, delete the others, and then upgrade again.
tabReservedColumn: The {{sheet}} tab in your published Google Sheet has a column named {{column}}, a name Telar 1.8.0 keeps for itself, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. In Google Sheets, rename or delete the {{column}} column in the {{sheet}} tab, and then upgrade again.
tabRowsChanged_rows_changed: The {{sheet}} tab in your published Google Sheet has an extra {{columns}} column, and Telar 1.8.0 can't publish the tab that way. We stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. In Google Sheets, delete the {{columns}} column from the {{sheet}} tab, check that no row now starts with # or is left empty unless you meant it to, and then upgrade again.
tabRowsChanged_header_row: The {{sheet}} tab in your published Google Sheet has an extra {{columns}} column, and Telar 1.8.0 can't publish the tab that way. We stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. In Google Sheets, delete the {{columns}} column and the second row of column names from the {{sheet}} tab, and then upgrade again. If you delete only the column, your site will publish that second row as content.
tabRowsChanged_unsafe: The {{sheet}} tab in your published Google Sheet has an extra {{columns}} column, and Telar 1.8.0 can't publish the tab that way. We stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. In Google Sheets, delete the {{columns}} column from the {{sheet}} tab, and then upgrade again.
tabUnreadableForRepair: Telar 1.8.0 can't publish the {{sheet}} tab in your Google Sheet while it has these columns, which it reads as the same field: {{columns}}. We stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. In Google Sheets, keep one of them in the {{sheet}} tab, delete the others, and then upgrade again.
sheetsSwitchUnreadable: We couldn't switch off Google Sheets for your site, because the google_sheets section of your site's _config.yml is written in a form the Compositor can't edit, so we stopped the upgrade before changing anything on your site. On GitHub, open _config.yml and write the google_sheets section as an indented block, one key per line, with enabled: true, and then upgrade again. The upgrade then switches it off for you.
sheetsDecisionIntro_one: Telar 1.8.0 can't publish the {{tabs}} tab in your published Google Sheet, because it has columns that Telar reads as the same field:
sheetsDecisionIntro_other: Telar 1.8.0 can't publish these tabs in your published Google Sheet, because each has columns that Telar reads as the same field:
sheetsDecisionOffer: The upgrade can stop your site from reading Google Sheets. It saves each tab, as it is now, to your repository as your site's sheets and fixes the columns there. From then on, you edit your content in the Compositor, and changes you make in Google Sheets won't reach your site.
sheetsDecisionKeepNote: If you keep Google Sheets, the upgrade stops without changing anything, and you fix the columns in Google Sheets before you upgrade again.
sheetsDecisionChanged: Your Google Sheet or your site changed since we asked, so we checked them again. Choose again.
sheetsSwitchHeading: Your site stops reading from Google Sheets
sheetsSwitchWritten: The upgrade saves these tabs to your repository as your site's sheets:
sheetsSwitchDeleted: It deletes these sheets from your repository, because the tabs above replace them:
sheetsSwitchedOffDone: Your site no longer reads from Google Sheets. It now publishes what you edit in the Compositor.
columnPickerIntro: Each group below holds columns that Telar reads as the same field, and more than one of them has values. Telar 1.8.0 can't publish a sheet like that. Choose the column to keep in each group; the upgrade will delete the others and their values.
columnPickerNeedsChoice: Choose a column to keep in this group.
columnPickerChoiceNeeded: Choose one column to keep in each group, and then continue.
columnPickerSheetsChanged: Your sheets changed while you were choosing, so we checked them again. Make your choices again below.
columnPickerFurther: Deleting those columns left more columns that Telar reads as the same field. Choose which to keep.
columnPickerIntroSite: Each group below holds columns that Telar reads as the same field, and more than one of them has values. Telar can't build the site from a sheet like that. Choose the column to keep in each group. The Compositor will delete the others and their values from the sheet in your repository, and then carry on.
columnPickerIntroSheets: Each group below holds columns that Telar reads as the same field, and more than one of them has values. Telar can't build the site from a sheet like that. Choose the column to keep in each group. The import will keep only that column's values, and your first publish will write the sheet to your repository without the others. Your Google Sheet won't change.
columnPickerNotApplied: The Compositor couldn't delete the other columns from "{{sheet}}" without changing which rows Telar reads, so nothing changed. Keep only the column you want in the sheet on GitHub, and then try again.
confirmIntro: Nothing changes on your site until you confirm.
sheetsCheckedAsTheyStood: We checked your Google Sheet as it was when you started the upgrade. If you change it after that, those changes will reach your site without this check.
answersHeading: Answers your site will publish differently
answersIntro: Telar 1.8.0 cuts an answer that doesn't fit on the story's card, and it publishes answers as text only. The upgrade doesn't change your sheets, so they keep the full text, but your published site will show these answers as described below until you edit them. An answer that is cut or loses content stops your next publish until you fix it.
answerCellsDropped: Step {{step}} of "{{story}}" has more cells than its sheet has columns, so your site won't publish what's in the extra cells.
repairDropped: {{sheet}}: deletes the empty column {{column}} and keeps {{keeper}}.
repairDroppedAllEmpty: {{sheet}}: deletes the empty column {{column}} and keeps {{keeper}}, which is empty too.
repairDroppedChosen: {{sheet}}: deletes the column {{column}} and its values and keeps {{keeper}}, as you chose.
repairHeaderRowDeleted: {{sheet}}: deletes the second row of column names, which Telar skips when it reads the sheet, so your site publishes the same rows as before.
repairMarked: {{sheet}}: keeps the empty first column {{column}} as {{markedAs}}, so Telar reads the same rows as before. Your site doesn't publish this column.
repairMarkedChosen: {{sheet}}: keeps the first column {{column}} and its values as {{markedAs}}, so Telar reads the same rows as before. Your site doesn't publish this column.
repairUnreadable: {{sheet}}: we couldn't read this sheet to check it, so the upgrade leaves it as it is.
syncNeeded: Before you publish again, sync your site. The upgrade changed values in your sheets that the Compositor's editor doesn't have yet. Until you sync, the editor's preview shows your site as it was before the upgrade.
